name: Nearness to the 52-week high across large coins

history.reason: Pre-registered test (UNIVERSE 1d, 2020-01..2025-10, defaults; run 20261113-075805-71f073; control large-basket top 20 / 365 days, run 20261113-075811-402ccb). Failed every rule: -64% vs +10% for the control, Sharpe 0.11 vs 0.38, drawdown -96% vs -87%, break-even 0 bps. Equity rose from 330 to 722 USDT in 2021 and fell 91% in 2022: always invested, it held the coins nearest their highs (LUNA, NEAR, MATIC) into the crash. 214 orders were rejected, nearly all small rebalances below the 5 USDT minimum after equity had collapsed.
